# Observational Activity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ObservationalActivity`](gmeow-ObservationalActivity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ObservationalActivity>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)

An activity whose primary purpose is to produce observations — a scientific survey, census, archaeological excavation, clinical trial, code review, audit, or any other structured act of observing, measuring, or asserting. A subclass of [`gmeow:Activity`](gmeow-Activity.md) (and therefore of [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md)) that generates [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md) individuals as first-class outputs. The event-type value vocabulary ([`gmeow:eventTypeSurvey`](../individuals/gmeow-eventTypeSurvey.md), …) marks specific kinds; no subclass taxonomy is introduced ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Activity`](gmeow-Activity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ObservationalActivity`](gmeow-ObservationalActivity.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Activity`](gmeow-Activity.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
